'''2006 World Championship 6 V-Card Tournament Brian Fred DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (6 V-Card Tournament); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Michael "mc9457" Carr (2006-11-04).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35782 Brian Fred's 6 V-Card Deck - DS Senate]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071213225428/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35782 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Brian Fred's 6 V-Card Deck - DS Senate'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "mc9457" Carr
* '''Published:''' November 4, 2006
* '''Rating:''' 4.88
* '''Description:''' Brian Fred's DS Senate Deck that he used for the 6 V-Card Tournament

=== Strategy ===

This deck went 2-1, with a full win against Jim Beyer and Scott Church, and a loss against Brian Hunter.
